This code tests `flowcut()`.

```{r}
install.packages("~/repos/flowmix-fork/flowmix", type = 'source', repos = NULL)

## Possibly remove all .o and .so files in src/. before doing this.
devtools::document("~/repos/flowmix-fork/flowmix")
devtools::build("~/repos/flowmix-fork/flowmix", vignettes = FALSE)
devtools::install("~/repos/flowmix-fork/flowmix", vignettes = FALSE)
```


Generate some data.

```{r}
library(flowmix)
## library(parallel)
##library(parallelly)
library(tidyverse)
  
## General setup
TT = 100
nt = 1000
prob1 = 3/4
fac = .2
dimdatt = 2
numclust = 2
##censoring_limit = 3.5
censoring_limit = 5
maxdev = .5
## maxdev = .225
  
## Amount of censoring
cens_vec_1 = c(-Inf,-Inf,rep(-Inf, dimdatt-2))
cens_vec_2 = c(Inf,censoring_limit, rep(Inf, dimdatt-2))
  
  
## Generate data
set.seed(100)
datobj <-   gendat_flowcut(TT = TT, fac = .2 , nt = nt,
                           cens_lim_l_vec = cens_vec_1,
                           cens_lim_u_vec = cens_vec_2)
datobj %>% list2env(envir = .GlobalEnv) %>% invisible()

## Roughly Plotting the data

y2 = ylist %>% sapply(function(a) a[,2])  %>% do.call(rbind, .)

y2 %>% matplot(type='p', pch = 16, col = rgb(0,0,0,0.1), main = "Dimension 2")
abline(h=censoring_limit, col = 'red')

  
## Fit model
```

Comparing flowmix and flowcut times


```{r}
censoring_limits = seq(from=4,to=1, length = 10)
number_of_censored_points =c()
flowcut_times = c()
for(icensor in 1:8){
  print(icensor)

  ## Generate data
  censoring_limit = censoring_limits[icensor]
  maxdev = .5
  
  ## Amount of censoring
  cens_vec_1 = c(-Inf,-Inf,rep(-Inf, dimdatt-2))
  cens_vec_2 = c(Inf,censoring_limit, rep(Inf, dimdatt-2))

  nt = 300
 
  ## Generate data
  set.seed(100)
  datobj <-   gendat_flowcut(TT = TT, fac = .2 , nt = nt,
                             cens_lim_l_vec = cens_vec_1,
                             cens_lim_u_vec = cens_vec_2)
  datobj %>% list2env(envir = .GlobalEnv) %>% invisible()

  ## Save number of censored points
  convert_obj = my_convert(ylist, censor_indicator_left,
                           censor_indicator_right)
  idx_cens_list = convert_obj$idx_cens_list
  number_of_censored_points[icensor] = sapply(idx_cens_list, length) %>% sum()

  
  begin_time = Sys.time()
  oneres <- flowcut_once(
      ylist = ylist,
      countslist = NULL,
      X = X,
      prob_lambda = 0.0001,
      mean_lambda = 0.0001,
      cens_indicator_list_left  = censor_indicator_left,
      cens_indicator_list_right = censor_indicator_right,
      cens_lim_vec_lower     = cens_vec_1,
      cens_lim_vec_upper     = cens_vec_2,
      maxdev = maxdev,
      numclust = numclust
  )
  end_time = Sys.time()
  total_time = (end_time - begin_time) %>% as.numeric()
  flowcut_times[icensor] = total_time/(oneres$final.iter-1)
}

flowmix_time = sapply(1, function(ii){
begin_time = Sys.time()
  oneres <- flowmix_once(
      ylist = ylist,
      countslist = NULL,
      X = X,
      prob_lambda = 0.0001,
      mean_lambda = 0.0001,
      maxdev = maxdev,
      numclust = numclust,
      verbose = TRUE
  )
end_time = Sys.time()
total_time = (end_time - begin_time) %>% as.numeric()
total_time/(oneres$final.iter-1)
})


## Plot the results
plot(x = censoring_limits[1:8],
     y = flowcut_times,type='o', col = 'black', lwd = 2, ylim = c(0,max(flowcut_times)),
     main = "Per-iteration times", ylab = "", xlab = "censoring limit")
abline(h=flowmix_time, col = 'red', lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("flowcut", "flowmix"), lty = c(1,2), col = c(1,2), lwd = c(2,2))
flowcut_times %>% round(2)
flowmix_time %>% round(3)

par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(
    x = number_of_censored_points[1:8],
     y = flowcut_times,type='o', col = 'black', lwd = 2, ylim = c(0,max(flowcut_times)),
    main = "Per-iteration times", ylab = "", xlab = "Number of censored points", log="x")
abline(h=flowmix_time, col = 'red', lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("flowcut", "flowmix"), lty = c(1,2), col = c(1,2), lwd = c(2,2))

plot(
    x = number_of_censored_points[1:8],
     y = flowcut_times,type='o', col = 'black', lwd = 2, ylim = c(0,max(flowcut_times)),
    main = "Per-iteration times", ylab = "", xlab = "Number of censored points")
abline(h=flowmix_time, col = 'red', lwd = 2, lty = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("flowcut", "flowmix"), lty = c(1,2), col = c(1,2), lwd = c(2,2))
```
